system_overview: PaperTestChecker is a full-stack system for automated grading of student test submissions (from photos or typed answers). Architecture: React 18 + Vite frontend serves a Single Page Application (SPA) with role-based views (Admin/Teacher/Student). ASP.NET 8 backend provides REST APIs for auth (JWT), test management, OCR processing (Tesseract.NET), submission grading (rule-based + LLM-assisted feedback), and resource recommendations. PostgreSQL stores users, tests, questions, submissions, results, and resources. Qdrant vector database enables semantic search for resource recommendations by embedding error descriptions and comparing with indexed reading materials. Python microservice (optional, local or via Hugging Face) handles embedding generation. All services run in Docker containers for local dev. Data flow: Student uploads photo -> OCR pipeline extracts answers -> stored submission -> grading engine compares with key and generates feedback with error tags -> RecommendationService queries Qdrant for top 3 resources -> Results displayed in frontend. Auth enforced via JWT middleware; role-based access controls restrict admin/teacher endpoints.

docker_compose_sketch:
version: '3.8'

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: testuser
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: testpass
      POSTGRES_DB: papertest
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U testuser"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:latest
    ports:
      - "6333:6333"
    volumes:
      - qdrant_data:/qdrant/storage
    environment:
      QDRANT_API_ENABLE_CONSOLE: "true"

  embedding-service:
    build:
      context: ./embedding-service
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "5001:5001"
    environment:
      FLASK_ENV: development
    depends_on:
      - qdrant

  backend:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Development
      ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection: "Host=postgres;Port=5432;Database=papertest;Username=testuser;Password=testpass"
      Qdrant__Url: "http://qdrant:6333"
      EmbeddingService__Url: "http://embedding-service:5001"
      Jwt__Secret: "your-secret-key-change-in-production"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      qdrant:
        condition: service_started
      embedding-service:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      VITE_API_URL: "http://localhost:5000/api"
    depends_on:
      - backend
    volumes:
      - ./frontend:/app
      - /app/node_modules

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  qdrant_data:

constraints_and_notes: SECURITY: JWT secret must be rotated in production; store in environment variable or secrets manager, never commit to repo.
SECURITY: Password hashing uses bcrypt (via a .NET library); never log or expose password hashes.
SECURITY: Implement rate limiting on auth endpoints (/register, /login) to prevent brute force attacks.
SECURITY: All file uploads to OCR must be validated for file type and size (max 8MB); scan for malware if possible.
PRIVACY: Student submissions and test data must remain encrypted at rest in production; use DB encryption or column-level encryption.
PRIVACY: OCR images may contain sensitive handwriting; do not persist images indefinitely; implement retention policy (e.g., delete after 30 days).
DEV: Local dev requires Docker; ensure docker daemon is running and docker-compose v2.20+ installed.
DEV: Postgres default creds in docker-compose are for dev only; change in production to strong random values.
DEV: Qdrant runs in memory by default in docker-compose; add persistent volume for data durability.
DEV: Embedding service uses sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model (~80MB); first run downloads model; CPU inference ~100-200ms per document.
EMBEDDING: For production, consider Hugging Face Inference API free tier (no GPU) or self-host with GPU accelerator (NVIDIA CUDA).
EMBEDDING: Vector dimension is fixed at 384 (for all-MiniLM-L6-v2); if changing embedding model, must re-embed all resources.
GRADING: MVP supports exact-match grading for MC and simple substring matching for short answers; LLM-assisted feedback can be added in future sprints.
GRADING: Partial credit for MC questions is unsupported in MVP; can be extended per question config.
RECOMMENDATIONS: If no vector DB results, fallback to keyword matching on resource tags; implement tag-based filtering.
QDRANT: Default config allows up to 50 concurrent connections; scale collection shards if >10k resources.
FRONTEND: SPA routing assumes backend serves index.html for any unknown routes (nginx.conf provided).
FRONTEND: JWT token stored in localStorage (acceptable for MVP); consider secure httpOnly cookie + CSRF token for production.
FRONTEND: Vite dev server proxies /api to backend; production build expects backend at same origin or CORS enabled.
TESTING: Unit tests for services; integration tests via E2E tests in Playwright; no unit tests for controllers (covered by E2E).
CI/CD: GitHub Actions runner cost is free for public repos; private repos have limited minutes; consider self-hosted runners for heavy pipelines.
ASYNC: All async operations in backend use async/await; ensure no blocking calls in middleware.
ERROR HANDLING: All endpoints return consistent error schema {code, message, details}; clients must handle 401/403 for auth failures.
ASSUMPTIONS: Single test-level scoring (uniform points per question) in MVP; multi-question difficulty weighting deferred to future.
ASSUMPTIONS: Admin role has full access; Teacher role limited to tests they created; Student role is read-only for tests and can only submit answers.
ASSUMPTIONS: OCR assumes single-page test submissions; multi-page papers require separate uploads.
ASSUMPTIONS: EmbeddingService is optional in dev; if not running, RecommendationService falls back to keyword match on resource tags.
